legacy_text: (\cos 2x)/(\cos x + \sin x)|= (\cos^{2} x − \sin^{2} x)/(\cos x + \sin x); = ((\cos x − \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x))/(\cos x + \sin x); = ((\cos x − \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x))/(\cos x + \sin x); = \cos x − \sin x
legacy_markdown:
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\cos 2x}{\cos x + \sin x} &= \frac{\cos^{2} x - \sin^{2} x}{\cos x + \sin x} \\
&= ((\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x))/(\cos x + \sin x) \\
&= ((\cos x - \sin x)(\cos x + \sin x))/(\cos x + \sin x) \\
&= \cos x - \sin x
\end{aligned}
$$
